body:
Private equity investor Endless LLP has closed Endless VI at £425m, providing fresh capital to back UK mid-market businesses with strong underlying potential.

Following an oversubscribed six-month fundraise, the firm will continue to work with business owners, management teams and corporate sellers on transactions where capital and hands-on operational support can help deliver lasting change.

Endless VI will focus on carve-outs, family-owned businesses, complex buyouts and turnarounds, typically investing between £20m and £60m in return for a controlling stake.

The Fund has received strong support from existing investors. Its global investor base includes universities, foundations, family offices, pension funds and financial institutions.

Over the past six months, Endless's transactions have included the management buyout of surface finishing and coatings specialist Anochrome Group, alongside the sales of Hovis to Associated British Foods and American Golf to an investment group owned by Peter Jones CBE.

Aidan Robson, managing partner at Leeds-headquartered Endless, said: "Endless VI allows us to keep backing businesses with strong underlying potential and working alongside management teams to help them move forward.

"Whether a business is changing hands, being carved out of a larger group or needs support to turn things around, our role is to bring capital and practical experience to the next phase."

Lucia Villamor, partner - investor relations at Endless, added: "We are very grateful to our investors and the Endless team for the commitment they have brought to this fundraise.

"It is particularly rewarding to see longstanding investors backing us again, and we look forward to putting that support to work for businesses across the UK."

Endless VI follows Endless V, which closed at £400m in November 2020.
